scope: Raft memory/durability primitives and bounded AppendEntries batches. Automatic production snapshot compaction/catch-up remains incomplete.
changes: Clear backing-array references during truncation, compaction and snapshot restore
Persist log append/truncate/snapshot before publishing in-memory mutation
Require current-state snapshot callback to cover exactly last-applied
Bound AppendEntries by64 entries and conservative1MiB command-weight budget; permit oversized single commands for compatibility
remaining: Production snapshot capture/restore with membership and exact application boundary
Atomic WAL replacement and retained-log compaction
Snapshot catch-up for disconnected followers and learners
Retry a failed state-machine apply without skipping entries:podster-ucm.2.2
Replace complete Pod-state serialization with per-Pod transactions:podster-ucm.12
limitations: The weight budget is a conservative estimate for normal command data, not a hard RPC byte limit. A single oversized command is still delivered alone.
The new batching catch-up test is a deterministic partition simulation; expanded suites also exercise real loopback gRPC and mTLS.
No BPF or real-container tests are required by these changes.
The native cluster check uses the signed patch rollout harness with two voters and a witness, fake workload runtime, leadership handoff and follower restart; it is not snapshot catch-up acceptance.
